name: Enterprise Dependency, Criticality and Impact
constraints: WM-XCT-037 is narrowed to identified dependency assertions, type bindings, conditions, epistemics, completeness and declarative propagation licences.
Criticality Assessment profiles WM-ACT-034 and is purpose-relative, scheme-qualified and time-bounded.
Dependency evidence remains a qualified binding to WM-KNW-008 or WM-MAT-008 and never copies payload mastership.
Graph paths support exposure inference only; causal attribution requires a separate evidenced WM-KNW-007 claim.
Impact outputs may inform WM-KNW-015 risk but never become risk determinations or authorization.
Unknown, not assessed, unresolved and asserted absent remain distinct.
